--- page 9 ---
BRAKES THAT WERE
BORN ON THE TRACK.
Look behind the GT’s 19-inch wheels and you’ll find vented
Brembo® brakes* — the same brand found on some of the
most prestigious cars of the last 40 years. They help give
you outstanding deceleration performance and precise
handling in a variety of conditions.†
BREMBO® HIGH-PERFORMANCE BRAKES*
GT’s powerful Brembo® brakes feature signature red,
fixed quad-piston front calipers and dual-piston rear
calipers. Larger overall brake rotors than the 2019
Porsche Panamera V6‡ help provide more consistent
braking performance†
BRAKE ASSIST SYSTEM (BAS)
If you suddenly slam on your brakes, BAS is designed to
sense the urgency and apply full braking power, which
can help shorten your braking distance†
ELECTRONIC BRAKE-FORCE DISTRIBUTION (EBD)
Based on the vehicle’s weight distribution, EBD helps
adjust the balance of braking power accordingly†
BRAKE FADE COMPENSATION
It automatically increases hydraulic pressure in the
braking system as the temperatures rise, so the driver
does not need to press as hard on the pedal. This
results in a more consistent and confident braking feel†
*Optional feature available only on certain trims. See kia.com for details. †No system, no
matter how advanced, can compensate for all driver error and/or driving conditions. Always
drive safely. ‡Based on published manufacturer specifications as of July 2019. GT2 SHOWN
